summary: Barclays PLC files a Form 6-K announcing the commencement of a share buy-back programme for up to £1 billion of its ordinary shares. The buy-back will run from 29 July 2026 to 28 January 2027, with shares purchased on the London Stock Exchange and cancelled to reduce share capital. Citigroup Global Markets Limited will act as riskless principal, making independent trading decisions within pre-set parameters. No repurchases will occur in the US or for ADRs. The programme is authorized by shareholders' 2026 AGM authority. Watch for execution pace and any regulatory changes; no arbitrage angle as this is a standard capital return.
